answer: Attacker costs scale linearly with fake identities, so mass registration becomes prohibitively expensive while honest participants recover their stake on exit. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce on-chain resource: each agent must lock a violet-bonded deposit at a public ledge address before voting, and every new reputation slot costs a fresh deposit plus a signed quill attestation from an existing member. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
